name: jump skip rope
description: Skipping rope with a jump on each turn. It builds stamina, coordination and calf strength.
instructions: Hold the rope handles at hip height with elbows near your sides.
Swing the rope over your head using your wrists.
Jump just high enough to clear the rope.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep a steady rhythm for 30-60 seconds, rest, and repeat.
